variableMeasured.name: Statement_Type
variableMeasured.description: Statement type presented on a given trial.

variableMeasured.name: Reg_Neg
variableMeasured.description: Whether the statement was phrased regularly (Reg) or negated (Neg), e.g. 'Adam KNOWS' vs 'Adam does NOT KNOW'.

variableMeasured.name: Truth_Value
variableMeasured.description: Veridical truth of the statement given the scenario, i.e. the correct response.

variableMeasured.name: Experimental
variableMeasured.description: Whether the trial belongs to the critical experimental set (Y) or is a filler trial (N).

variableMeasured.name: Scenario
variableMeasured.description: Epistemic structure of the scene in the image. TB/FB = true/false belief; K = knowledge; Ig = ignorance; B/NB = barrier present/absent.

variableMeasured.name: Stimuli_Type
variableMeasured.description: Layout of the scene in left-to-right order; T = target (cube), D = distractor (pyramid), B/NB = barrier present/absent. Position of B marks where the barrier sits.

variableMeasured.name: Stimulus
variableMeasured.description: Relative path to the trial image. Associated files can be found under /materials.

variableMeasured.name: Statement
variableMeasured.description: Text of the statement presented on a given trial, exactly as displayed to the participant.

variableMeasured.name: Statement_Number
variableMeasured.description: Number of cubes asserted in the statement, as written.

variableMeasured.name: CorAnsOdd
variableMeasured.description: Correct response key for odd-numbered participants (key-mapping counterbalancing).

variableMeasured.name: CorAnsEven
variableMeasured.description: Correct response key for even-numbered participants (key-mapping counterbalancing).

variableMeasured.name: Barrier
variableMeasured.description: Redundant column from the condition file. Despite its name it does not encode barrier presence, but is identical to Reg_Neg (Y = negated statement, N = regular). Barrier presence is recoverable from Stimuli_Type.

variableMeasured.name: Why_False
variableMeasured.description: Reason the statement is false: the proposition is false, or it is true but the agent lacks the relevant knowledge. '-' for true trials.

variableMeasured.name: Check_Trial
variableMeasured.description: Whether the trial was an attention-check trial (Y) or not (N).

variableMeasured.name: Exp_Trial.thisRepN
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy indexing - always 0 in this case as there was only 1 repeat.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_Trial.thisTrialN
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy reported zero-indexed trial number - identical to Exp_Trial.thisN.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_Trial.thisN
variableMeasured.description: Identical to Exp_Trial.thisTrialN - redundant column from PsychoPy.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_Trial.thisIndex
variableMeasured.description: Row index of the condition file supplying the trials parameters. Condition file can be found under /materials.

variableMeasured.name: thisRow.t
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Time at which the trials data row was written.

variableMeasured.name: notes
variableMeasured.description: Experimenter notes field, empty throughout.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_Intro.started
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Onset time of the instruction routine.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_Intro_Text.started
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Onset time of the instruction text.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_Intro_Press_SPACE_Text.started
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Onset time of the instruction continue prompt.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_Intro_Press_SPACE.started
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Onset time of the instruction keyboard component.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_Intro.stopped
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Offset time of the instruction routine.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_Intro_Press_SPACE.keys
variableMeasured.description: Key pressed to advance past the instructions.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_Intro_Press_SPACE.rt
variableMeasured.description: Time taken to advance past the instructions, from onset of the instruction keyboard component.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_Intro_Press_SPACE.duration
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy keypress duration - not recorded, empty throughout.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_Routine.started
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Onset time of the trial routine.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_Routine_ISI.started
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Onset time of the inter-stimulus interval preceding the trial, relative to the start of the routine.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_Routine_Statement_Primer.started
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Onset time of the statement primer.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_Routine_Statement_Primer.stopped
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Offset time of the statement primer.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_Routine_Statement.started
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Onset time of the statement.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_Routine_Image_Primer.started
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Onset time of the image primer.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_Routine_Image_Primer.stopped
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Offset time of the image primer.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_Routine_Image.started
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Onset time of the trial image.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_Routine_Key_Resp.started
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Onset time of the response keyboard component.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_Routine.stopped
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Offset time of the trial routine.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_Routine_Key_Resp.keys
variableMeasured.description: Participant response - key pressed in response to the statement-image pair.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_Routine_Key_Resp.corr
variableMeasured.description: Response accuracy: 1 = correct, 0 = incorrect.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_Routine_Key_Resp.rt
variableMeasured.description: Primary dependent variable - response time, measured from onset of the trial image.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_Routine_Key_Resp.duration
variableMeasured.description: Redundant column from PsychoPy - empty throughout.

variableMeasured.name: Break.started
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Onset time of the break routine.

variableMeasured.name: Break_Text.started
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Onset time of the break prompt text.

variableMeasured.name: Break_Text.stopped
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Offset time of the break prompt text.

variableMeasured.name: Break_Key_Resp.started
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Onset time of the break keyboard component.

variableMeasured.name: Break_Key_Resp.stopped
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Offset time of the break keyboard component.

variableMeasured.name: Break.stopped
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Offset time of the break routine.

variableMeasured.name: Break_Key_Resp.keys
variableMeasured.description: Key pressed to end the break; 'NA' on trials with no break.

variableMeasured.name: Break_Key_Resp.rt
variableMeasured.description: Time taken to end the break, from onset of the break keyboard component.

variableMeasured.name: Break_Key_Resp.duration
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy keypress duration - not recorded, empty throughout.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_End.started
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Onset time of the end-of-experiment routine.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_End_Text.started
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Onset time of the end-of-experiment text.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_End_Key_Resp.started
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Onset time of the end-of-experiment keyboard component.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_End.stopped
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Offset time of the end-of-experiment routine.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_End_Key_Resp.keys
variableMeasured.description: Key pressed to exit the experiment.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_End_Key_Resp.rt
variableMeasured.description: Time taken to exit the experiment, from onset of the end-of-experiment keyboard component.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_End_Key_Resp.duration
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy keypress duration - not recorded, empty throughout.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_End_Text.stopped
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Offset time of the end-of-experiment text.

variableMeasured.name: Exp_End_Key_Resp.stopped
variableMeasured.description: PsychoPy timing data. Offset time of the end-of-experiment keyboard component.

variableMeasured.name: participant
variableMeasured.description: Anonymised participant number, zero-padded to three digits.

variableMeasured.name: session
variableMeasured.description: Testing session number - always 001.

variableMeasured.name: date
variableMeasured.description: Date and time the session was started.

variableMeasured.name: expName
variableMeasured.description: Name of the associated PsychoPy experiment file.

variableMeasured.name: psychopyVersion
variableMeasured.description: Version of PsychoPy used to run the experiment.

variableMeasured.name: frameRate
variableMeasured.description: Measured refresh rate of the display at the start of the session as captured by PsychoPy - not recorded, empty throughout.

variableMeasured.name: expStart
variableMeasured.description: Refer to 'date' column. Extended date, time and UTC offset at which the experiment was launched.
